pages.text: Copper and glass. Use it on a creature to draw one dram of an aspect. It holds $(l)4 drams$() of one aspect at a time.$(br2)Which aspect it draws depends on the $(l)needle$(). Right-click a needle onto the syringe in your inventory to fit it; right-click with an empty hand to pull it out.$(br2)Sneak and use it to squirt it empty.

pages.title: Needles
pages.text: $(item)Iron$(): Density. Iron is heavy.$(br)$(item)Gold$(): Speed. Gold tools are the fastest.$(br)$(item)Bone$(): Size. Bone is the frame of a body.$(br)$(item)Amethyst$(): Time. Amethyst resonates.$(br2)Nothing yet draws Awareness.
